svg.title: UC-P07 - Check Out a Private EV

g.text: UC-P07 - Check Out a Private EV
Preconditions: Student is signed in and has a parking-session reference.
Service calls use the signed-in Student's identity.
[invalid or unverifiable context, or already checked out]
End this attempt without a new checkout or release.
Command acknowledgement alone does NOT confirm charging stopped.
Wait for confirmed stopped state or failure/timeout
[access invalid, stop failed or final state unconfirmed]
[stop required and declined, denied, failed or still unconfirmed]
No checkout. Resume only after access and charging state are resolved.
[latest state unavailable, inaccessible or charging Active again]
[owned Active parking verified with no Active charging]
[visit already closed, latest state unavailable, inaccessible or charging Active again]
Reload context in a new attempt. Any confirmed charging stop remains effective.
[Final state check and complete checkout together]
One update: session Closed; reservation Completed; actual unrounded departure;
unused Pending/Scheduled requests Cancelled. Release occupied parking, ALL remaining
parking holds (including early-departure remainder) and remaining charging allocations once.
Preserve completed charging history. Serialize against charging start and dependent changes.
Already closed returns the existing result without another release.
[charging became Active or cancellation consequences changed]
[current state unverifiable or record no longer accessible]
With no linked charging, checkout affects only parking.
Failure or cancellation of checkout NEVER restarts charging confirmed stopped.
An uncertain checkout result must be reconciled before retrying.
Smart E-Mobility Hub | Submission 2 | Parking & Private EVs
Thin rectangle: execution of a responsibility; nested rectangle: nested execution
Solid arrow: request / action | Dashed arrow: returned result
Activation ends before waiting for Student input. Read guards top to bottom.
critical: required consistency boundary; updates are all-or-none as noted
